description: Source code for the STMicroelectronics ISM330DHCX 6-axis IMU sensor driver, including external sensor support and configuration functions.

methods.name: ism330dhcx_shub_write_slave_reg
methods.description: Writes data to a slave register via the sensor hub.

methods.name: ism330dhcx_shub_read_slave_reg
methods.description: Reads data from a slave register via the sensor hub.

methods.name: ism330dhcx_shub_enable
methods.description: Enables or disables the sensor hub.

methods.name: ism330dhcx_shub_set_data_channel
methods.description: Configures data channels for external sensors.

methods.name: ism330dhcx_shub_get_idx
methods.description: Gets index of external sensor by type.

methods.name: ism330dhcx_shub_init
methods.description: Initializes the sensor hub and external sensors.
